title: REQ · The app serves the generated PNGs and BootScene preloads them with no fallback
summary: Vite serves game/public so assets/<path> URLs resolve, and BootScene loads every scene asset
description: Context: BootScene loads from 'assets/<path>', but Vite's default publicDir is game/frontend/public, which holds stale SVG copies and no PNGs; art:generate writes to game/public/assets. Desired: publicDir points at game/public. BootScene preload, resolveKey and ensureAnim already work from the manifest and need no change. Expected: every scene id loads and registers animations from manifest frame counts. Why: otherwise the new PNGs never reach the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given vite.config.ts, when publicDir is read, then it resolves to game/public
Given the real manifest and scene, when BootScene.preload runs, then image and spritesheet loads use assets/<png path> and spritesheet frame sizes come from the manifest
Given every scene asset id, when resolveKey runs, then it never returns the fallback key
Given the boy sheet, when idle, walk and interact are created, then frame arrays are 4, 6 and 4 long

preserve: BootScene transition, keyboard, focus and animation code
